candidate.description: Process 700 (Campaign Engine) PROCESS.md evaluated against the unified template v6.0.0 invariant set — 10 invariant-set layers across 3 clusters (Identity/Contract/Governance mapped to Thing/Flow/Change). Run 1 — propose only, no lock.

elements.description: L1 — The document exists at declared CTB position with all three cluster headers (Identity/Contract/Governance).
elements.format: Single parseable markdown document with three cluster headers present.
elements.evidence: PROCESS.md exists at factory/outreach/700-campaign-engine/. Sections 1-2 = Identity, Sections 3-7 = Contract, Sections 8-13 = Governance. All three clusters present.

elements.description: L5 — Process Identity: two tables (Process table 10 fields + HEIR table 8 fields = 18 total).
elements.format: 18 named fields across two fixed tables.
elements.evidence: Section 1 has Process ID, Name, Business Silo, Sub-Hub, CTB Position, ORBT, Strikes, Last Deployed, BAR Reference, Deployed URL, Cron, Runtime — covers most but uses non-standard field names (Last Deployed vs Last Modified, no Medium field, no Authority field). heir.yaml provides 8/8 HEIR fields. 2 fields missing or non-standard from the canonical 18.

elements.description: L6 — Purpose block: 2-3 sentences naming what breaks without this process.
elements.evidence: Section 2 present. Names the break: 'the entire pipeline is a dossier factory with no output.' Names downstream: terminal, webhooks feed back to Process 100.

elements.description: L7 — Resources: four tables (Dependencies, Downstream Consumers, Tools & Integrations, Secrets).
elements.format: Four tables with fixed column schemas.
elements.evidence: Section 4 has Tools & Integrations (5 columns), Secrets (4 columns). Section 8 has Dependencies (upstream with status) and Downstream Consumers. All four tables present.

elements.description: L8 — IMO Declaration: Two-Question Intake + Input + Middle table (5 columns) + Output + Circle.
elements.format: Five sub-components with Middle table as 5-column schema.
elements.evidence: Section 3 contains all five: (1) Two-Question Intake with both questions answered, (2) Input block with 4 bullet items, (3) Middle table with 5 columns x 5 steps, (4) Output block with 3 items, (5) Circle block describing webhook feedback to Process 100.

elements.description: L9 — Data Schema (OSAM): READ table, WRITE table, Join Chain, Forbidden Paths.
elements.format: Four sub-sections with fixed column schemas.
elements.evidence: Section 5 has READ table (6 rows, 3 columns), WRITE table (4 rows, 3 columns), Join Chain (tree notation from sovereign_company_id), Forbidden Paths (6 rows, 2 columns), plus Query Routing. All four required sub-sections present.

elements.description: L10 — Structure Extraction (DMJ): Define table (L19), Map table (L20), Join table (L21) in forced order.
elements.format: Three ordered tables: Define (5 cols), Map (3 cols), Join (3 cols).
elements.evidence: NOT PRESENT in proper DMJ format. Section 6 has C&V declarations (constants list, variables list, mathematical definitions, step-level comparators) but no explicit Define/Map/Join tables as specified by L19/L20/L21. The join chain in Section 5 partially covers L21 intent but not in DMJ table format. All 3 DMJ steps missing.

elements.description: L11 — Constants & Variables Declaration: two lists (constants = structure, variables = fill).
elements.format: Two bullet lists with fixed semantics.
elements.evidence: Section 6 present with Constants list (8 items with comparators, primitives, tolerances) and Variables list (8 items). Also includes mathematical definitions (P(x;θ), r(x), stability) and step-level comparators with C_1 through C_6.

elements.description: L12 — Guard Rails: stop conditions table (Condition/Action), minimum 6 canonical from Bedrock.
elements.evidence: Section 7 has 10 stop conditions in Condition/Action table. Includes all 6 canonical: (1) can't answer intake, (2) no CID records, (3) Composio errors >5, (4) Mailgun errors >20%, (5) HeyReach errors >20%, (6) Strike 3. Plus 4 domain-specific. Exceeds minimum.

elements.description: L13 — Verification: numbered executable steps + Three Primitives Check.
elements.format: Two sub-sections: numbered steps with expected results, 3-question binary check.
elements.evidence: Section 9 has 7 numbered steps each with expected results. Three Primitives Check present with all three questions (Thing/Flow/Change) and binary answers. Complete.

elements.description: L14 — Measurement: Process Metrics (L22) + Sigma Tracking (L23) + ORBT Gate Rules (L24).
elements.format: Three sub-sections: metrics table (5 cols), sigma tracking table (6 cols), ORBT gate table (3 cols).
elements.evidence: Section 10 has metrics table (L22) with 6 metrics ✓. Sigma tracking (L23) present as placeholder table ✓. ORBT Gate Rules (L24) present as 4 bullet points but NOT in structured 3-column From/To/Gate table format. Tool Scorecard present as bonus. Partial — L24 format deviation.

elements.description: L15 — Execution Trace: 14-field per-step trace schema, append-only.
elements.format: One schema with 14 named fields per step entry.
elements.evidence: NOT PRESENT. Section 11 (Logbook) is session-level with 7 fields (ORBT, Trigger, Records processed, Errors, Tools used, Result, Learnings). This is NOT the per-step 14-field execution trace schema (trace_id, run_id, step, target, actual, delta, status, error_code, error_message, tools_used, duration_ms, cost_cents, timestamp, signed_by). Entire schema missing.

elements.description: L16 — Certification Record (Logbook): 7-field birth certificate, created only after BUILD→OPERATE sign-off.
elements.format: One entry schema with 7 fields: heir_ref, orbt_entered, orbt_exited, action, gates_passed, signed_by, signed_at.
elements.evidence: NOT PRESENT. Process is in BUILD so no logbook entries are expected (correct per Bedrock §8). However, the schema itself should be declared as a placeholder. Schema not declared.

elements.description: L17 — Fleet Learning: Failure Pattern Registry (7 cols) + Strike Rules.
elements.evidence: Section 12 (Known Issues & Strike Tracking) has 7 columns (#, Date, Issue, Root Cause, Fix, Strikes) — 6 named columns plus row number. Close to the 7-column Failure Pattern Registry (Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, First Seen, Occurrences, Strike Count, Status) but uses different column names and semantics. Strike Rules referenced in Section 7 (Strike 3 → Troubleshoot/Train) but not in the dedicated 1→repair, 2→scrutiny, 3→T/T format.

elements.description: L18 — Session History: 3-column append-only table (Date, What, Knowledge Record ID).
elements.evidence: Section 13 present with 3 columns: Date, What Was Done, imo-brain Document. Maps to L18 format (Date/What/Knowledge Record ID). 1 entry. Correct format.

elements.description: L24 — ORBT Gate Rules: 4 transitions in From/To/Gate structured table.
elements.format: Table with 3 columns (From, To, Gate), 4 rows for the 4 state transitions.
elements.evidence: Section 10 has ORBT gate rules as 4 bullet points (sigma tightening→lock, sigma flat→investigate, sigma expanding→back-propagate, strike 3→T/T). Content is correct but format is bullet-point prose, not the structured 3-column table (From/To/Gate) required by L24. Missing the explicit 4 transitions: BUILD→OPERATE, OPERATE→REPAIR, REPAIR→OPERATE, Any→T/T with gate conditions.

unidentified.description: Campaign content templates per movement signal type — referenced as 'NOT STARTED' in Section 8 Dependencies but no structural layer in the invariant set covers template content.
unidentified.reason: Blocker for execution but not a structural layer in the process document standard. May need classification as a resource dependency or a variable fill element.

unidentified.description: HeyReach integration — documented as PENDING in dependencies. No API key configured.
unidentified.reason: Runtime dependency, not a structural element. Affects smoke test execution but not document structure validation.

cluster_header_gap.measurement: Count of missing cluster headers out of 3 required (Identity/Contract/Governance). 0 = all present.

identity_field_gap.measurement: Count of missing or non-standard fields out of 18 required (10 process + 8 HEIR). 0 = all present and standard.
identity_field_gap.detail: Missing: (1) 'Medium' field not declared in process table, (2) 'Authority' field not declared. heir.yaml provides 8/8 HEIR fields.

imo_sub_component_gap.measurement: Count of missing IMO sub-components out of 5 required (Two-Question Intake, Input, Middle table, Output, Circle). 0 = all present.

osam_section_gap.measurement: Count of missing OSAM sub-sections out of 4 required (READ, WRITE, Join Chain, Forbidden Paths). 0 = all present.

dmj_step_gap.measurement: Count of missing DMJ steps out of 3 required (Define table L19, Map table L20, Join table L21) in proper tabular format. 0 = all present.
dmj_step_gap.detail: All 3 DMJ steps missing in proper format. Section 6 has C&V content but not as Define/Map/Join tables. Section 5 join chain partially covers L21 intent but wrong format.

guard_rail_deficit.measurement: max(0, 6 - count_of_stop_conditions). Measures shortfall below the 6 canonical minimum. 0 = meets or exceeds minimum.
guard_rail_deficit.detail: 10 stop conditions present. Exceeds canonical 6 by 4.

verification_gap.measurement: Count of missing verification sub-components out of 3 required (numbered steps with expected results, Three Primitives Check with all 3 questions). 0 = all present.

measurement_sub_section_gap.measurement: Count of missing or improperly formatted measurement sub-sections out of 3 required (L22 metrics table, L23 sigma tracking, L24 ORBT gate rules table). 0 = all present and properly formatted.
measurement_sub_section_gap.detail: L22 metrics table ✓, L23 sigma tracking ✓, L24 ORBT gate rules NOT in 3-column From/To/Gate format (present as bullet prose only).

trace_field_gap.measurement: Count of missing fields from the 14-field per-step execution trace schema. 0 = complete schema declared. 14 = entire schema absent.
trace_field_gap.detail: No per-step execution trace schema declared. Section 11 is a session-level logbook (7 fields), not the 14-field step-level trace.

orbt_transition_gap.measurement: Count of missing ORBT state transitions out of 4 required (BUILD→OPERATE, OPERATE→REPAIR, REPAIR→OPERATE, Any→T/T) in structured From/To/Gate table format. 0 = all present.
orbt_transition_gap.detail: Content exists as 4 bullet points but none in the structured 3-column table format. The 4 canonical transitions (with gate conditions) are not explicitly declared.

certification_schema_gap.measurement: Count of missing fields from the 7-field certification record schema. 0 = schema declared (even if empty during BUILD). 7 = schema not declared.
certification_schema_gap.detail: No certification record schema placeholder declared. Expected during BUILD — no entries, but schema should exist.

fleet_learning_format_deviation.measurement: Count of column name mismatches between actual failure tracking table and the canonical 7-column Failure Pattern Registry schema. 0 = exact match.
fleet_learning_format_deviation.detail: Actual columns: #, Date, Issue, Root Cause, Fix, Strikes (6 cols). Canonical: Pattern ID, Location, Error Code, First Seen, Occurrences, Strike Count, Status (7 cols). Only Strike Count maps directly. 5 column name/semantic mismatches plus 1 missing column (Status). Strike escalation rules (1→repair, 2→scrutiny, 3→T/T) not in dedicated format.

key_proposal.description: The proposed key for Process 700 is: a structurally complete executable process document whose 10 invariant-set layers all produce 0 deviation against the unified template v6.0.0 standard. The key is the invariant set itself — the 10 comparators measuring deviation from the structural standard.
key_proposal.reason: Run 1 — no lock permitted. 7 of 16 evaluated layers show non-zero deviation. Primary structural gaps: L15 (execution trace schema entirely absent), L16 (certification schema not declared), L17 (fleet learning format mismatch), L10 (DMJ tables missing), L24 (ORBT transitions not tabulated).
